about: Master plan and work queue for Claude threads, built from items Cal approved in docs/product-backlog.md. Threads may change only status, passes, pr and notes. Cal adds, removes or reorders tasks. Status values: todo, in_progress, done, blocked.

plan.how_to_pick: Take the lowest 'order' task whose status is todo, whose depends_on tasks are all done, and whose lane is not used by any running thread (including UI threads). One task per thread.

lanes.tooling: scripts/, package.json devDependencies, CI-adjacent test tooling
lanes.editor: apps/web/app/reports/[id]/page.tsx, components/ObservationEditor.tsx, SignaturePad.tsx, lib/localDraft.ts, lib/serverStore.ts saveDraft, app/engineer.css

plan.ui_work: Cal's standing priority: the UI must be clear, easy to use, professional and inviting. UI tasks from the 'UI clarity and polish' thread are added here with their own lane mapping; a UI task that edits editor or office files uses that lane.
plan.audit: Statuses and notes below come from a read-only audit of main at 13e96a0 on 2026-10-20 (AUDIT-1). No browser checks have ever been run for these tasks; Playwright is not installed.

tasks.title: Audit task statuses against the code
tasks.description: Some approved items may already be partly or fully built (corrections, PM acknowledgement and draft recovery work landed 7-14 Sept). Check each task below against the code, tests and docs/optimisation-progress.md.
acceptance: Every other task's notes say what already exists, with file paths
Tasks that are fully built and tested are proposed as done in the PR description, not set to done without evidence
No application code changes in this PR
tasks.notes: Done read-only on 2026-10-20; results are in each task's notes.

tasks.title: Make browser checks runnable in cloud threads
tasks.description: Acceptance steps need browser checks, but Playwright is not installed, so scripts/verify-*.mjs cannot run. Add Playwright as a dev dependency using the preinstalled Chromium, and document the command in CLAUDE.md.
acceptance: npm ci installs Playwright without downloading browsers (PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD)
At least one scripts/verify-*.mjs runs green in a cloud thread after npm test && npm run build
CLAUDE.md names the exact command
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20: playwright 1.56.1 pinned as a root dev dependency (its Chromium revision 1194 is the one in /opt/pw-browsers). npm ci downloads no browsers, with or without PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD. verify-role-access and verify-engineer-layout pass; engineer-layout was updated for UI changes since September. verify-pdf-navigation fails on a real app fault: pdfjs-dist 6.3 calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which Chromium 141 lacks, so the PDF viewer shows an error in older browsers. Not fixed here (outside this task).

tasks.title: Explicit PM acknowledgement
tasks.description: PM acknowledgement with actor, timestamp and optional note, kept separate from server receipt, delivery, approval and issue closure. Sending never waits for acknowledgement.
acceptance: Acknowledgement records actor and timestamp, optional note
It is stored and shown separately from receipt, delivery, approval and closure
Tests for the acknowledgement record
tasks.notes: Built: serverStore.ts acknowledgeReport, route, office dialog (ProjectsView 'Read' row beside Received, Review, PDF and notification). 2026-10-20: tests/corrections.test.ts now asserts actor, id, timestamp and trimmed optional note are stored; receipt time, review, delivery and the raised issue are untouched; approval and issue closure do not set it; status.ts keeps each fact's own words. No application code changed.

tasks.title: Preserve signatures across reloads
tasks.description: A signature captured in a draft survives a reload.
acceptance: Sign, reload, signature still shown and saved to the server
Test covering signature persistence
tasks.notes: Done 2026-10-20 in PR #6: the name and drawing save with the draft as draftSignature (server and device copy) and become signature on sending. Tests: apps/web/tests/signatures.test.ts. Browser check: scripts/verify-signature-reload.mjs (light and dark). Not checked on a physical phone.

tasks.title: Hide the review queue when review is disabled
tasks.description: Review remains off by default; its queue is hidden when off.
acceptance: With review off, no review queue or count appears in the PM view
Test or browser check for both settings
tasks.notes: 2026-10-20: lib/reviewQueue.ts reviewInUse decides per project (review required, or a submitted report still pending). With it off the office hides the Inbox To review and Returned filters, the Issues Not reviewed filter and count, and the register's review wording. Checked by tests/reviewQueue.test.ts and scripts/verify-review-queue.mjs (in use, then off). Report rows still tag a report that is itself pending or returned, and the report reader keeps its Review row.

acceptance: Home screen lists unfinished reports with project and last-saved time
Browser check
tasks.notes: Partial: EngineerWorkspace shows drafts for the selected project only; device-only drafts and other projects are not surfaced.

The update can be expanded and edited again
Browser check of the engineer report screen on a phone-width viewport

tasks.title: Suggest responsible companies and locations

tasks.title: Traceable corrections and revisions
tasks.description: Corrections create traceable revisions rather than overwriting sent reports, and resulting issue changes keep their report provenance.
acceptance: A correction creates a new revision; the sent snapshot is unchanged
Issue changes from a correction record which revision made them
Tests for revision and provenance
tasks.notes: Mostly built: correctReport creates a new revision; snapshot unchanged. Issue provenance is note text only (IssueEvent has no reportId/revision); no test that the sent snapshot is unchanged.

tasks.title: Living site diary

acceptance: Timeline built only from existing report data
Each entry links to its report and revision
Tests for timeline assembly; browser check
tasks.notes: Not started. Depends on structured issue provenance from FE-6b.

acceptance: Scope of the extension agreed with Cal before building
